==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am a contestant on a New Age reality game show themed around aliens and crystals. Each contestant is given a clear blue tube containing a red ticket. This ticket acts as a contestant's password for playing the game each week and grants each contestant a unique ability.

If you lose the ticket, you lose the game. There is a slimy green blob of goo with with a mouth of jagged fangs. The blob has attached itself to a white wooden door inside a brick building.

The next challenge of the show will be to find a way to remove the blob from the door. My ticket has a power that would be perfect for this challenge, but I can't attend the next game session due to a prior commitment. A fellow contestant, a wide hipped redhead woman with long curly hair and piercing blue eyes wearing a a striped pink shirt and blue jeans, wants me to leave my ticket tube with them while I am gone. 

I am conflicted on whether or not I can trust any of the other contestants with my tube, but I want to help them win the next challenge even while I am gone. Before I can come up with a solution to help my fellow contestants, I wake up.
